title: chore: remove the public feeds from the Classic workers
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Removed the public image.pollinations.ai/feed and text.pollinations.ai/feed streams and stopped publishing generation events to them. Both paths now return 404 rather than starting a feed or treating “feed” as a prompt. The image nofeed and text private parameters remain accepted but have no effect; their public-feed guidance was removed from APIDOCS.md. The feed-only FeedHub Durable Object, its Worker bindings, the image feed’s mature-word list, and related tests and fixtures were removed.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli gently closes two little doors marked “IMAGE /feed” and “TEXT /feed” beside a lime green (#ecf874) glowing terminal, while code-plants grow around it. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, wears a tiny caretaker’s scarf, and appears only once in the scene, with chunky retro sprites, a warm cream and soft pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
